defs.def: to get pleasure from sth 享受 … 的乐趣；欣赏；喜爱

ex.s: While eating and enjoying street performances, they chat with each other and share stories of their daily lives.
ex.t: 人们一边吃吃喝喝、欣赏街头表演，一边相互聊天，分享日常生活的故事。

ex.s: The spacious dining room is regularly filled with customers enjoying dumplings and a variety of noodle and rice dishes.
ex.t: 宽敞的餐厅里经常坐满享用饺子以及各种面食和米饭菜肴的顾客。

ex.s: A month after visiting the French Riviera and enjoying the sandy beaches of Nice and Menton, I went hiking with friends in the Pala group.
ex.t: 在游览法国里维埃拉、享受尼斯和芒通沙滩一个月后，我和朋友去Pala山群徒步。

ex.s: Consumers enjoy reading and giving reviews.
ex.t: 消费者喜欢阅读和撰写评价。

ex.s: 00 amWork at the project sites, or enjoy your free time
ex.t: 10:00 am 在项目点工作，或享受自由时间

ex.s: He enjoyed the local cuisine.
ex.t: 他很喜欢当地的美食。

ex.s: The Carlow Autumn Walking Festival is a great opportunity for the beginner, experienced or advanced walker to enjoy the challenges of Carlow’s mountain hikes or the peace of its woodland walks.
ex.t: Carlow秋季徒步节是初学者、有经验或高阶徒步者享受Carlow山地徒步挑战或林间漫步宁静的绝佳机会。

ex.s: Breathtaking views of the lowlands of Carlow can be enjoyed in the presence of welcoming guides from local walking clubs.
ex.t: 在当地徒步俱乐部热情向导的陪伴下，你可以欣赏卡洛低地令人惊叹的景色。

ex.s: Bring along your camera and enjoy the wonderful views along this well-surfaced forest path.
ex.t: 带上相机，沿着这条铺设平整的森林小径欣赏美景吧。

ex.s: They enjoy living abroad.
ex.t: 他们喜欢住在国外。

ex.s: The atmosphere here made the meal all the more enjoyed.
ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 这里的氛围让这顿饭更加令人享受。

ex.s: But why doesn’t everyone enjoy exercising?
ex.t: 但为什么不是每个人都喜欢锻炼呢？

ex.s: They can also enjoy themselves in the themed classes like Harry Potter or Winter Wonder-land Baking.
ex.t: 他们还可以在哈利·波特或冬季仙境烘焙等主题课上尽情玩耍。

ex.s: He enjoyed being alone.
ex.t: 他喜欢独处。

ex.s: Learn where to look for animals and how to safely enjoy your wildlife watching experience.
ex.t: 学习在哪里寻找动物，以及如何安全地享受观察野生动物的体验。

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: Back downtown during a workday, they can enjoy a more domestic form of this interaction by walking along a fountain on their lunch break.
ex.t: 回到市中心的上班日，他们可以在午休时间沿着喷泉散步，享受这种互动的一种更居家化的形式。

ex.s: People enjoy living close to nature.
ex.t: 人们喜欢住得离自然近一些。

ex.s: Campers enjoy a staff-to-child ratio ranging from 1:4 to 1:7 depending on the age group.
ex.t: 营员享受的员工与儿童比例在1:4到1:7之间，取决于年龄组。

ex.s: She enjoys being a housewife.
ex.t: 她享受做家庭主妇。

ex.s: This is how a piece of art makes you feel, and whether or not you appreciate or enjoy that feeling.
ex.t: 这是一件艺术品带给你的感受，以及你是否欣赏或享受那种感觉。

ex.s: Informed by neuroaesthetics, the next time I create my art I will value the process even more, enjoying the activation of the aesthetic triad in my brain as I admire the vivid images that I have created.
ex.t: 在神经美学启发下，下次我创作艺术时会更重视过程，享受大脑中审美三联体被激活，同时欣赏我创造的生动图像。

ex.s: For many years, I enjoyed living with my dogs, Tilly and Chance.
ex.t: 多年来，我很享受和我的狗Tilly和Chance一起生活。

ex.s: They enjoyed much respect.
ex.t: 她们有一个带浴缸的房间。

ex.s: Young children across the globe enjoy playing games of hide and seek.
ex.t: 对他们来说，_21_别人的目光并让自己不被看见是一件非常刺激的事情。

ex.s: As soon as she graduated from high school she left home to live on Catalina Island off the Californian coast, away from her parents, where she enjoyed a life of sailing and off-road biking.
ex.t: 她一从高中毕业就离开家，住到加州海岸外的卡塔利娜岛上，远离父母，享受航海和越野骑行的人生。

ex.s: Instead, enjoy its diversity.
ex.t: 相反，我享受它的多样性。

ex.s: One Monday morning, while the children were enjoying “free play”, I stepped to the doorway of the classroom to take a break.
ex.t: 一个周一早晨，当孩子们正享受自由玩耍时，我走到教室门口休息一下。

ex.s: If we keep our body fit, we can enjoy life in a better manner.
ex.t: 如果我们保持身体健康，就能更好地享受生活。

ex.s: He was enjoying carving things in his workshop一but he wanted to create something with more purpose.
ex.t: 他喜欢在工作坊里雕刻东西——但他想创作更有意义的东西。

ex.s: Which hotel best suits people who enjoy an active social life?
ex.t: 哪家酒店最适合喜欢活跃社交生活的人？

ex.s: He enjoys the traditional way of life.
ex.t: 他享受传统的生活方式。

ex.s: They enjoyed exploring new places
ex.t: 她们喜欢探索新地方

ex.s: They enjoy guessing callers’ identity.
ex.t: 他们喜欢猜来电者的身份。

ex.s: The universe is all yours to explore and enjoy.
ex.t: 宇宙完全属于你去探索和享受。

ex.t: 享受结识有趣的人

ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途的风景。

ex.s: If your child enjoys being in the kitchen, then the culinary camp is definitely the right fit.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子喜欢待在厨房，那么烹饪夏令营一定适合他。

ex.s: They enjoyed hearing about all the forbidden fruit I had collected.
ex.t: 后来有一个圣诞节，我收到了一份惊喜礼物——一个大而精美的木箱子，是我儿子Bruce把我那个想象的奶奶的箱子变成了现实。

ex.s: She enjoys telling jokes.
ex.t: 她是一位严格又聪明的老师。

ex.s: The bridge was closed to motor traffic so people could enjoy a walk across it.
ex.t: 这座桥禁止机动车通行，这样人们就能享受步行过桥的乐趣。

ex.s: To enjoy the scenery on the way.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途的风景。

ex.s: Discover and enjoy 4 centuries of history, 5 acres of celebrated and award-winning gardens with parkland walk.
ex.t: 探索并享受四个世纪的历史、5英亩屡获殊荣的花园和公园步道。

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
ex.t: 探索、欣赏Tullie House这个获奖场所，这里将历史收藏、当代艺术和家庭乐趣汇集在一个令人印象深刻的博物馆和美术馆中。

ex.s: A Enjoy Ronney’s works.
ex.t: A 欣赏罗姆尼的作品。

ex.s: My dad don’t like the soup and I don’t enjoy apples.
ex.t: 爸爸不喜欢那碗汤，我也不喜欢苹果。

ex.s: To enjoy the scenery on the way.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途的风景。

ex.s: I enjoyed reading stories aloud.
ex.t: 我喜欢大声朗读故事。

ex.s: "Hats, sweaters, gloves — I enjoy it all.
ex.t: "帽子、毛衣、手套——我都喜欢。

ex.s: But mostly, I enjoy giving everything away."
ex.t: 但最重要的是，我喜欢把一切都送出去。"

ex.s: He enjoys trying new ways to help others.
ex.t: 他喜欢尝试新的方式来帮助他人。

ex.s: the parent to enjoy quiet reading
ex.t: 让家长享受安静的阅读。

ex.s: With shining dark eyes, he seems like the of kid who would enjoy public speaking.
ex.t: 他闪着乌黑的眼睛，看起来像是会喜欢公开演讲的孩子。

ex.s: Enjoy interesting stories.
ex.t: 喜欢有趣的故事。

ex.s: She enjoys embarrassing her guests.
ex.t: 她喜欢让嘉宾难堪。

ex.s: Wander among a variety of shops selling gifts while enjoying a live music show and nice street entertainment.
ex.t: 在售卖礼品的各类店铺间漫步，同时享受现场音乐表演和精彩的街头娱乐。

ex.s: No wonderD．Enjoy yourself

ex.t: 15．（1分）如果我们昨天赶上了那趟航班，我们现在就会在海滩上享受假期了。（  ）

ex.s: Families can enjoy the experience together, too, with Family Camp programs for families with children as young as 7.
ex.t: 家庭也能一起享受这种体验，因为有为7岁以下儿童家庭准备的"家庭营"项目。

ex.s: Campers, in my eyes, were people who enjoyed insect bites, ill-cooked meals, and uncomfortable sleeping bags.
ex.t: 在我眼中，露营者是那些喜欢蚊虫叮咬、半生不熟的食物和不舒服睡袋的人。

ex.s: Enjoy the holiday scenes.
ex.t: 欣赏节日场景。

ex.s: I enjoyed studying difference kings of cars and planes, playing pop music, and collecting the late music albums.
ex.t: 我喜欢研究不同种类的汽车和飞机，演奏流行音乐，收集最新的音乐专辑。

ex.s: She enjoys learning the Italian language.
ex.t: 她喜欢学习意大利语。

ex.s: He enjoyed the drink         B.
ex.t: 他很享受那杯饮料 B．

ex.s: You’ll learn to enjoy literature—as you remember what you read!
ex.t: 你会学会欣赏文学——同时记住你所读的内容！

ex.s: Everyone enjoys the life-saving benefits vaccines provide, but they’ll exist only as long as everyone shares in the risks.
ex.t: 每个人都享受着疫苗提供的救命益处，但只有当每个人都共同承担风险时，疫苗才能持续存在。

ex.s: And while many Brits like nothing better than spending their Sunday cutting the grass, some are happy just to sit under the branches of the trees and enjoy the beauty of the world around them.
ex.t: 虽然许多英国人最喜欢的事情莫过于在周日修剪草坪，但有些人也乐于坐在树枝下，享受周围世界的美丽。

ex.s: If your child sees you enjoying your work and taking pride in a job well done, they’re far more likely to do the same.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子看到你享受工作并为把事情做好感到自豪，他们也更有可能这样做。

defs.def: to be happy and get pleasure from what you are doing 过得快活；玩得痛快；得到乐趣

ex.s: If you’re among the groups of people who are enjoying the mental and physical health benefits of surrounding yourself with plants, don’t beat yourself up if one (or a few!) doesn’t make it.
ex.t: 如果你是那些享受植物环绕带来的身心健康益处的人群之一，不要因为有一两株（或几株！）枯死而自责。

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 它们终年美丽，邀你欣赏最微小的细节，从微风中草的声响到奇形怪状的种子头的雕塑般形态。

ex.s: If you enjoy cooking, for example, you may faithfully follow a recipe without questioning the instructions.
ex.t: 例如，如果你喜欢烹饪，你可能会忠实地遵循食谱，而不质疑其中的说明。

ex.s: I “like what they are to people, and I enjoy bringing things back,” he said.
ex.t: Inglis说电话亭让他想起了一个物品经久耐用的时代。

ex.s: What did John enjoy doing in his childhood?
ex.t: 约翰童年时喜欢做什么？

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。

ex.s: In the coming months, we are bringing together artists form all over the globe, to enjoy speaking Shakespeare’s plays in their own language, in our Globe, within the architecture Shakespeare wrote for.
ex.t: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将汇聚来自全球各地的艺术家，在我们的环球剧场、在莎士比亚当年写作时所设计的建筑中，用他们各自的语言来演绎莎士比亚的戏剧。

ex.s: Here you can enjoy 4 pours of some of the best wine San Francisco has to offer.
ex.t: 在这里你可以品尝到4杯旧金山最好的葡萄酒。

ex.s: In the coming months, we are bringing together artists form all over the globe, to enjoy speaking Shakespeare’s plays in their own language, in our Globe, within the architecture Shakespeare wrote for.
ex.t: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将汇聚来自全球各地的艺术家，在我们的环球剧场、在莎士比亚当年写作时所设计的建筑中，用他们各自的语言来演绎莎士比亚的戏剧。

ex.s: Whatever our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who also enjoy doing them, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: 无论我们的爱好是什么，互联网都能让我们与那些也喜欢这些爱好的人建立联系，即使他们生活在世界的另一端。

defs.def: to have sth good that is an advantage to you 享有；享受

ex.s: Led by the concept of “right plant, right place,” they match plants that enjoy the same soil, sun and weather conditions, and arrange them according to their patterns of growth.
ex.t: 在“合适的植物，合适的位置”这一理念引领下，他们把喜好相同土壤、阳光和天气条件的植物搭配在一起，并按其生长模式排列。

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画创作的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: I’m enjoying the creative activities, and it feels great to have done something useful.”
ex.t: “我很享受这些创造性活动，做了有益的事感觉很棒。”

ex.s: These specialists could work at the office until ten each night, then look back and realize they would have loved to have gone home and enjoyed the sweetness of their family and friends, or traveled to exciting places, meeting interesting people.
ex.t: 这些专家可能在办公室工作到每天晚上十点然后回头看才发现他们本可以早点回家享受家人朋友的甜蜜或者去激动人心的地方旅行结识有趣的人。

ex.s: Oliver says if you're   2   (luck) enough to have someone close to you who enjoys cooking, ask them   3   you can join in when it's possible.
ex.t: 奥利弗说，如果你2(幸运)足够有 与你亲近的人谁喜欢做饭，问他们3,你可以加入 当有可能。

ex.s: They enjoyed the highest status.
ex.t: 他们享有最高的地位。

ex.s: The best exercise is one that you enjoy and will do.
ex.t: 最好的运动是你喜欢的并且会坚持的运动。

ex.s: I must say that I have certainly come to enjoy camping.
ex.t: 我必须说我确实已经开始喜欢露营了。

ex.s: Enjoy fun history as we take you through San Francisco for a free taste of ice cream.
ex.t: 在旧金山免费品尝冰淇淋的同时，享受有趣的历史之旅吧。

ex.s: People should have good taste to enjoy life．
ex.t: A．人应有好品味才能享受生活。

ex.s: Many people enjoy herbal tea because it can have a positive effect on energy levels.
ex.t: 很多人喜欢喝花草茶，因为它能对精力水平产生积极的影响。

defs.def: （祝愿时说）玩痛快些，过愉快些，好好欣赏

ex.s: I enjoy sharing moments of my life with her.
ex.t: 我喜欢和她分享我生活中的点滴时刻。

ex.s: But despite the wind and the rain, I still enjoy working outside in the wild.
ex.t: 但尽管有风有雨，我仍然喜欢在野外户外工作。
